title: Sum of Consecutive Subarrays
summary: Given an array of integers, calculate the sum of the values of all consecutive subarrays, where a subarray is considered consecutive if the difference between consecutive elements is either 1 or -1.
statement: Given an array of integers, calculate the sum of the values of all consecutive subarrays, where a subarray is considered consecutive if the difference between consecutive elements is either 1 or -1. Return the result modulo 10^9 + 7. An array of length 1 is also considered consecutive.
constraints: A subarray is consecutive when all steps are +1 or all steps are -1; every singleton qualifies.
Sum the element sums of all qualifying subarrays modulo 1,000,000,007.
reference_solution:
def sum_consecutive_subarrays(nums):
    modulus=1_000_000_007;answer=0;up_count=down_count=0;up_sum=down_sum=0
    for index,value in enumerate(nums):
        if index and value==nums[index-1]+1:up_count+=1;up_sum+=up_count*value
        else:up_count=1;up_sum=value
        if index and value==nums[index-1]-1:down_count+=1;down_sum+=down_count*value
        else:down_count=1;down_sum=value
        answer+=up_sum+down_sum-value
    return answer%modulus
